findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "acubic_get_portfolio" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: acubic_get_account, acubic_create_strategy · Private data: acubic_get_portfolio · Public sink: acubic_get_account, acubic_get_backtest, acubic_run_backtest, acubic_project_strategy, acubic_get_strategy_history · Destructive: acubic_get_backtest, acubic_get_backtest_status, acubic_run_backtest, acubic_delete_strategy, acubic_cancel_backtest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: acubic_get_account, acubic_create_strategy · Private data: acubic_get_portfolio · Public sink: acubic_get_account, acubic_get_backtest, acubic_run_backtest, acubic_project_strategy, acubic_get_strategy_history · Destructive: acubic_get_backtest, acubic_get_backtest_status, acubic_run_backtest, acubic_delete_strategy, acubic_cancel_backtest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
